items.title: the four session.compaction events are dropped; the reference client draws a compaction item with a running status and streams its summary, bred shows nothing
items.notes: Found by the 2026-11-25 event-union hunt. Reference behaviour (ext/code/lib/opencode/chunks/shared-events-m77rqa4a.js: session.compaction.started inserts {type:"compaction", status:"running", reason, summary, recent}, .delta appends summary, .ended marks it done, .failed records the error). bred has no compaction handling at all (grep compaction outside lib/opencode: only man-parse .Bl -compact). Decide the legacy shape (a message.part.updated part type, or a new event) before writing the red test; a long session compacts and the transcript currently jumps without saying so. Decision (2026-11-25): a log line, not a transcript item. translate() emits one legacy session.compaction with phase started|ended|failed; the handler appends Ui.appendMsg(..., { log: 1 }) for the buffer's own session. The short summary from the ended event is flattened and capped at 200 chars; deltas are not drawn because the ended text is authoritative. A fixture with a compaction is still the missing measure input.

items.title: session.tool.input.delta is dropped; the tool preview only appears when the whole input has arrived
items.notes: Found by the same hunt. Reference: shared-events case "session.tool.input.delta" appends data.delta to tool.state.input while the tool is streaming. translate handles .started and .ended (which parses the JSON) but not .delta, so bred shows a pending tool with no input until it is complete. Decide whether the text preview is worth a legacy event; the .ended text is authoritative, so this is display-only.

items.title: dmsetup(8) splits load|reload into two words around a .BR line ending in \c
items.notes: Measured at c1f2f38a: man-diff --page /usr/share/man/man8/dmsetup.8.gz says 3222 ours / 3221 man, lost 1 ["load|reload"], with ours as "load|" + "reload". Source is `.BR load | \c` followed by `.CMD_RELOAD` (a .de body whose only line is `.BR reload`), after `.BR compact ", " inverted ", " notrunc .` under .HP, and before `.br`. A minimal .BR load | \c + .de CMD_RELOAD + .BR reload DOES join correctly in bred, so the trigger is context-dependent (the preceding .BR line, the .HP, or the macro body shape). Prove the trigger before fixing; p96 fixed the text-line variant and p98 the no-output-macro variant, so check both before changing the join state. The fix moved the page pin in test/man-diff.mjs from 1 to 0, so that file joins the row.

items.title: the loop has no clock it can enforce: put start/deadline/stopNew in the tracked queue, print the budget in status, and refuse a round after stopNew
items.notes: The 2026-11-25 11:51Z run stopped at 12:28 having set a 15:06 stopNew and never read the clock again: the stop condition lived in prose and in an untracked file nothing parsed. The clock moves to doc/loop/queue.json run (tracked, so a fresh session inherits it), bin/loop-clock.mjs holds the pure budget/canStart logic, status prints it, and round refuses after stopNew unless --force. lastRoundMs is recorded so the printed ETA uses a measured round, not a guess.

items.title: batch: the man tail's register claims (p45, p120)
items.notes: Absorbs p45 (.nr x +N/-N is relative) and p120 (.nr X with no value leaves it undefined). One commit, each item keeps its own test, both are marked done with this row's hash. The read-creates half of p120 stays refused: an unknown register outside a condition is a typo the policy refuses.

items.title: batch: the character forms (p94, p95)
items.notes: Absorbs p94 (\N[ 65] skips leading spaces inside the bracket) and p95 (\[charN] is a glyph lookup: 0..255 exists, above it prints nothing instead of a Unicode code point). p89 (\[char0]) is a triage, not part of this: groff prints a NUL byte, and the model refuses NUL by the decision rounds 33-35 pinned for \N 0.

items.title: batch: a join through an empty macro, and Sm off before a text line (p98, p33)
items.notes: Absorbs p98 (a \c before a macro with an empty body: the body now pushes a frame, so the carry works) and p33 (.Sm off also suppresses the space before a text line: groff prints -ab; our text branch forced spaceNext before appending). p98's .ft/.ll half was already fixed by p125, and the .PP/.RS/.sp warning is respected (a body line that breaks still drops the join).

items.title: a no-output request that defines or removes still swallows a pending \c join (p54 covered only .ft)
items.notes: Groomed 2026-11-25, residual of p54: `.BR load | \c` + `.ds X y` + `reload` — groff prints `load|reload`; bred prints `load| reload`. Also red for .nr and .rm (the same textOut==0 branch covers .rn/.rr/.als/.ev). Red test `macros :: a c join survives a request that only defines or removes`. Widen the restore of joinNext to any request that printed nothing and left the line unbroken; the .PP/.RS/.sp/.br cases must still break.

items.title: mdoc body text after .Sh is bold here and roman in groff (mdocHeading leaves c.font bold)
items.notes: Found while grooming p119 on 2026-11-25: `.Sh NAME` followed by a plain text line renders bold in mdoc mode; groff -Tutf8 -mdoc prints it roman. mdocHeading does not restore c.font. Needs a red test first: after parsing, the text span's style is roman.

items.title: check accepts any ancestor hash as a done hash, so a done item can point at an unrelated commit
items.notes: Found 2026-11-25: round 57 marked c11 done with 1947f160, a peer grooming commit with no Loop-item trailer, while the fix was on a lane branch that never merged. check verified only that the hash is on main. A doneHash must be a commit whose body carries Loop-item: <id>, or a batch trailer naming the item; anything else is a problem. Test: a scratch repo with a done row pointing at an unrelated commit is refused.
